title: Mom Calls the POLICE on Beluga for 'Grand Theft Hacking'!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: GUYS just stole like a million coins from the server bank! I'm rich!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: BELUGA WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Mom?! What are you doing here? It's just a game!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: A GAME?! IT SOUNDS LIKE YOU'RE CONFESSING TO A CRIME! 'STOLE A MILLION COINS'?! ARE YOU HACKING?!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: No! It's a virtual bank in 'Roblox Tycoon Master 3D'! I just grinded a lot for it!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: GRINDED?! DON'T YOU LIE TO ME! I SAW YOU TYPING 'I'M GOING TO BREK INTO THE MAIN FRAM'.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: WHAT?! No, I said 'break into the *mine farm*' for more diamonds! Auto-correct!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: TOO LATE! I ALREADY TOLD THE POLICE EVERYTHING! THEY'RE ON THEIR WAY TO YOUR 'MAIN FRAM'!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: Hello. Is this 'Beluga'?

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Uh, yes officer. But it's all a misunderstanding, I swear!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: We have received a report of grand theft and attempted "mainframe intrusion." Can you confirm your current physical location?

title: Mom Calls POLICE on Beluga for 'Cracking Games'!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Hecker told me about this new mod that lets you cracck any game for free!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: *crack

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: BELUGA WHAT ARE YOU DOING

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: ARE YOU HACKING INTO THE GOVERNMENT AGAIN? I SEE 'CRACK' ON YOUR SCREEN!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Mom no, it's just a game mod! To unlock stuff!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: UNLOCKING STUFF FOR FREE IS STEALING! I SAW IT ON 60 MINUTES!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: I'M CALLING THE POLICE! YOU ARE DOING SOMETHING ILLGAL!!!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: MOM NO DON'T! It's not illegal! It's just a game!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: Beluga? This is Officer Ramirez. We've received a report about 'grand theft hacking'.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Officer, it's a huge misunderstanding! My mom saw me 'cracking' a game!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: 'Cracking' a game, you say? That sounds like a serious offense, son. Are you admitting to digital larceny?

messages.author: Police
messages.content: We're outside. Step away from the computer and come out slowly.

title: MOM CALLED THE COPS ON ME FOR BANNING MY GIRLFRIEND!

messages.author: Pablo
messages.content: Girlfriend, that was your final warning. No more spamming random memes in #important-announcements.

messages.author: Pablo
messages.content: You're banned. Effective immediately.

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: BANNED?! From YOUR server?! How DARE you! This is literally the worst thing to ever happen to me!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: I'm telling mo. You're going to regret this, Pablo.

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: *mom

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: PABLO, WHAT IS THE MEANING OF THIS NONSENSE?!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: MY DAUGHTER SAYS YOU 'BANNED' HER! ARE YOU TRYING TO SABOTAGE HER SOCIAL LIFE?! IS THIS SOME KIND OF CYBERBULLYING PLOT??

messages.author: Pablo
messages.content: Mom, it's just a Discord server. She broke the rules, it's not a big deal.

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: A 'DISCORD SERVER'? IT SOUNDS LIKE SOME KIND OF SHADY, UNDERGROUND ORGANIZATION! I WILL NOT HAVE YOU OPERATING A DIGITAL GANG AND EXCLUDING MY CHILD!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: I'M CALLING THE AUTHORITIES. THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE BEHAVIOR. YOU ARE BANNED FROM MY HOUSE FOREVER!

messages.author: Pablo
messages.content: Wait, what?! You can't just-

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: TOO LATE. THE POLICE ARE ON THEIR WAY TO INVESTIGATE YOUR 'SERVER' OPERATION. GOOD LUCK EXPLAINING THIS TO THEM!

title: Beluga Calls COPS on Pablo for 'Normie Meme' Ban!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: Pablo, are you serious?! You just BANNED me from your server!

messages.author: Pablo
messages.content: My server, my rules, Girlfriend. No 'animated gifs of dancing hamsters' in #serious-announcements. You know the drill.

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: Dancing hamsters?! That's a temporary ban at MOST! I'm telling Beluga about this! He won't stand for it!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Girlfriend, what happened? Pablo banned you? That's not fair!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: He's abusing his admin power! I'm reporting him to the highest authorities! This is an outrage!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Highest authorities?! Oh no, Girlfriend, don't worry, *I'll* handle it! police

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: *police

messages.author: Police
messages.content: Sir, we received an alarming call about a 'ban' and 'abused power.' Can you specify the nature of the emergency?

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Pablo banned Girlfriend from his server! It's an injustice! He's a menace to the internet!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: Is this a physical ban, sir? Has anyone been physically restrained or harmed? We need details.

messages.author: Pablo
messages.content: BELUGA! ARE YOU SERIOUS?! YOU CALLED THE COPS OVER MY 'ULTIMATE MEME LORDS' SERVER?! SHE SPAMMED NORMIE MEMES!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: 'ULTIMATE MEME LORDS'?! Pablo, that's your 'top secret, exclusive' server?! I can't believe this!

title: MOM CALLS FBI ON BELUGA FOR 'CAT MUG'!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Okay, got the goods. Meeting point's the usual. Need to figure out discreet way to get them to you.

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: BELUGA. WHAT 'GOODS'? WHAT MEETING POINT IS 'THE USUAL'? ARE YOU DEALING?!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: OMG MOM! WRONG CHAT! Delete that plz!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: Beluga, why are you sending cryptic messages? Is your mom really freaking out about 'goods'?

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: HE'S HIDING SOMETHING! BELUGA, I SWEAR IF YOU'VE JOINED SOME ILLEGAL OPERATION! I WILL CALL THE POLICE ON YOU MYSELF!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: No! Mom, it's not like that! It's a surpirse for Girlfriend!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: A 'surpirse'? You mean 'surprise'? And why is your mom threatening to call the police over it?

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: SURPRISE? I DON'T CARE IF IT'S FOR THE QUEEN! 'GOODS' AND 'MEETING POINTS' SOUNDS LIKE A CRIME! I'M DIALING THE FBI!

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Chill out, Mom. Beluga's 'goods' are actually a limited edition cat-themed mug for Girlfriend's collection. The 'meeting point' is his bedroom desk, and the 'discreet way' is wrapping it without her seeing.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Hecker! You always ruin everything!

messages.author: Girlfriend
messages.content: A cat mug? Beluga, you're so sweet! But also, you're a menace to your mom's heart.

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: A MUG?! I ALMOST CALLED THE FBI OVER A CERAMIC MUG?!

title: MOM CALLS POLICE ON BELUGA FOR HECKER'S 'SPECIAL BLEND'!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Hecker, a package just arrived for me. Thought it was my new gaming headset.

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Ah, my 'delivery'. Perfect timing. Don't open it if it's not yours.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: TOO LATE I ALREADY DID 😭😭

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: HECKER WTF IS THIS. It's a bag of weird green stuff and some tiny pills. IS THIS LIKE... BAD STUFF?

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Calm down, Beluga. It's just my organic 'special blend'. And some supplements for focus.

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: BELUGA WHAT IS THAT AWFUL SMELL IN YOUR ROOM?! ARE YOU SMOKING SOMETHING?!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: MOM IT'S NOT MINE! IT'S HECKER'S PACKAGE! I SWEAR I DIDN'T KNOW!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: I SEE A BAG OF... WEIRD GRENN LEAVES AND PILLS! I'M CALLING THE POLICE RIGHT NOW!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: NO MON PLEASE! HECKER TELL HER!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: *mom

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Mom, it's organic matcha green tea powder and veterinary anxiety pills for Mittens. She gets stressed during thunderstorms.

title: Mom Calls Police on Beluga for 'Server Invasion'!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: OH MY GOD GUYS MY SERVER IS GETTING RAIDED!!! Bots everywhere, channels *spamed*!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: BELUGA WHAT ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT?! RAIDED?! ARE YOU HOME ALONE?!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: MOM NO IT'S MY DISCORD SERVER! I mean, *spammed*! It's just bots!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: DISCORD? IS THAT A CODE WORD FOR A HACKER GANG?! I HEARD YOU YELLING!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: I WAS YELLING AT THE BOTS, NOT AT REAL PEOPLE! MOM DON'T DO IT!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: TOO LATE. THE POLICE ARE ALREADY ON THEIR WAY. I TOLD THEM THERE WERE INTRUDERS.

messages.author: Police
messages.content: This is Officer Miller. We've arrived at the residence. Is everyone safe?

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: OFFICER, IT'S A HUGE MISUNDERSTANDING! MY MOM THOUGHT MY DISCORD SERVER WAS BEING INVADED BY REAL RAIDERS!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: I WAS PROTECTING HIM! THEY WERE SPAMMING HIS POGGR SERVER WITH GIBBERISH!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: MOM, IT'S *POGGER*! NOT 'POGGR'! It's just a chatroom!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: Ma'am, your son's "pogger server" appears to be a digital community. "Raiders" in this context refer to online spammers, not physical attackers.

messages.author: Police
messages.content: No physical crime has been committed. Just... a lot of digital noise.

title: Mom Calls POLICE on Beluga for 'Exploiting' Hamsters!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Hecker, almost done with the code for the new patch? My fans are getting antsy!

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Almost. Just finishing the 'exploit' to bypass the new anti-cheat. My code will brek it.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: *break it. Nice! Can't wait for flying hamsters!

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: BELUGA, WHAT ARE YOU 'BREAKING'?! AND WHO IS THIS 'HECKER' TALKING ABOUT 'EXPLOITS' AND 'ANTI-CHEAT'?

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: Mom! It's just for my game, a mod! Hecker helps me code.

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: AN EXPLOIT IS ILLEGAL! ARE YOU TRYING TO HACK THE GAME COMPANY? OR WORSE, A BANK?!

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Relax, Ma'am. It's an *ethical* exploit. For *creative expression* within a virtual world.

messages.author: Mom
messages.content: I AM CALLING THE AUTHORITIES! THIS SOUNDS LIKE CYBERCRIME! YOU'RE CORRUPTING MY SON WITH YOUR 'ETHICAL EXPLOITS'!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: NO MOM DON'T CALL THE POLIEC! IT'S JUST A GAME ABOUT PETS!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: *police. This is Officer Miller. We received a report of cybercrime. Explain these 'exploits' and 'flying hamsters'.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: It's a mod for my pet sim game! We're making hamsters fly a tiny spaceship around a tiny planet!

messages.author: Police
messages.content: So, no actual cybercrime, just... highly ambitious hamster space travel? Ma'am, your son is fine. His hamsters are just very adventurous.
